fields.description: Physical booklet number as written on the paper booklet cover, e.g. "25" or "VIP-1". Also the docname (autoname: field:booklet_number).
fields.label: Booklet Number

fields.description: Active -> Stalled (no matching Delivery Report for the configured stall window) -> Ready for Review (pages filled or end number reached) -> Closed (staff signed off). Maintained by the hourly check_booklet_lifecycle scheduler job, not editable set-and-forget by staff except Closed.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Active
Stalled
Ready for Review
Closed

fields.description: First invoice number on this booklet's first page.
fields.label: Start Number

fields.description: Last invoice number on this booklet's last page.
fields.label: End Number

fields.description: A VIP booklet is dedicated to one recurring customer - any Delivery Report whose invoice number falls in this booklet's range auto-suggests that customer when backfilling an invoice (Module 16).
fields.label: VIP Booklet

fields.description: Page numbers within this booklet's range marked void (paper page written, sale cancelled/never happened) - excluded from the daily reconciliation checklist (Module 17) once listed here.
fields.label: Void Entries
